Letter From The Founder
DR. S. DIVYASENA
Reminiscing My Journey as a Teacher…
Everyday has been a new learning experience with the art. I started teaching with the motive of sharing
what I had learned from natyam to as many young minds as possible. I gradually started realising that
through teaching I was able to discover several aspects of natyam, and it has been a joyful teaching‑
learning experience for me. As a performer, the connec on with the audience and their happiness a er
watching my natyam gave time contentment. As a teacher, the most joyous moment was when my students
pursued the art form and were appreciated. I must admit that teaching an ar orm is a very challenging
task, but at the end of the day watching the world of natyam flourish in my students mind and soul makes
me the happiest person.
I am forever indebted to the love and support of my dear mother Smt Lakshmi and my brother Sri Baskar.
They were my pillars of support, and made time what I am today. Hear elt thanks to my husband ‑ Sri B P
Haribabu and my family for their constant support and encouragement. Sincere gra tude to Smt Kalanidhi
Narayanan, Guru Sri Vempa Chinnasatyam, Sri J Sooryanarayana Murthy, and Sri Jai Kishore Mosalikan
and all my inspira ons in this ar orm for guiding time and for being the footsteps that paved my path in
natyam.
“Not all the fingers are the same”. As the saying goes, every dancer has a unique talent. I strive hard to
make all my students realise their uniqueness and poten al. Along with natyam my students learn thalam,
ithihasam, puranas and moral values to impart “Poorna Vidhya”. I have been blessed with wonderful
students who have been of great support to me. I always try to make Divyanjali their second home.
I am very happy to have received the love, encouragement and help from all the parents of my students,
throughout these 30 years. Divyanjali has faced several ups and downs in these 30 years. I would like to
thank each and everyone who has been there during the good and hard mes of Divyanjali. Nothing is
impossible when the Almighty supports us. With “His” divine blessings I will con nue my humble efforts to
teach natyam and spread the joy of this Bhakthi margam.

Divyanjali
a Narrative

The Beginning
Divyanjali Dance School was established in 1994 by Dr. S. Divyasena and since then, the school has come a
long way in producing dancers of remarkable talent and has earned itself a place among the best dance
schools for training in Bharatanatyam, in Chennai. The school, to its credit, inaugurated its own workspace
in the year 2004 in the presence of Smt. Chithra Visveshwaran and Smt. Nandhini Ramani.
The well formulated syllabus that the school follows in impar ng training, both in the theore cal and
prac cal aspects of dance, has been carefully dra ed by the founder, keeping in mind the requirements
and abili es of students of various age groups. The prescribed syllabus has been published as a book
“Essence and Essen als of Dance” authored by Dr. S. Divyasena in the year 2006. Besides the prac cal
training and the theore cal aspect, students of Divyanjali also receive a special focus on Laya, the
rhythmical aspect of dance from Shri. B. P. Haribabu, a leading percussionist and secretary of Divyanjali
Trust. Abinaya, the expressive aspect in Bharatanatyam, is imparted in the children by crea vely engaging
them in the teaching process.
Accomplishments
Divyanjali Dance School got registered as a Trust in the year 2011 and received grant from Government of
India and Tamil Isai Sangam with the help of which Divyanjali produced a couple of thematic productions,
“Nava vidha Sambandham” and “Andal Vaibhavam”.
Divyanjali dance school celebrated its 70th Arangetram in the year 2026. Dr. S. Divyasena has also
conducted an Arangetram abroad.

Divyanjali’s biggest assets are its students who have won numerous laurels to the school.
They have become recipients of prestigious scholarships like the CCRT scholarship ‑ instituted by the Govt. of
India, Bharat Kalachar Scholarship, Iyal Isai Nataka Mandram Scholarship. They have also proved their time le
in various competitions conducted across India and abroad and won prizes in Cleveland Thyagaraja Festival,
All India Dance Festival conducted by Kalamandir College of Fine Arts ‑ Kannur, Nrithyathi
Kalakshetram ‑ Raipur, Navya Nataka Sami ‑ Hyderabad, Akhil Bhara ya Sanskru k Sangh ‑ Pune,
Natyarangam Competition and Spirit of Youth competition ‑ Music Academy, Chennai.
Students have beentirecipients of Dr. Padma Subramanian Endowment Award, VDS Best Dancer Award,
Indian Fine Arts Best dancer, and Nalanda Nritya Nipuna award. We also have students who have completed
their masters in Bharatanatyam and who are ranked as graded artists by Doordarshan Kendra. Many senior
students of Divyanjali have become dance teachers of leading dance institutions and have begun their own
dance schools across India and abroad – USA, UK and Singapore.
Divyanjali has conducted several workshops. Amongst them, Prayathanam’s Parivarthanam is a notable one,
where we had eminent speakers conduc ng workshops to our students.
A huge setback and strong come back
Divyanjali faced a huge setback in the year 2015 during the Chennai floods. We consider our
choreographies in digital format, library books and musical instruments as our treasure. It was
disheartening to lose all our treasures in the flood when our entire workspace was filled with 7 . water.
However, Divyanjali did not lose hope and revived in fullest accelera on with the help and support from
many institutions and legends such as꞉
 ABHAI
 Music Academy
 Narada Gana Sabha
 Smt. Chithra Visveshwaran
 Smt. Nandhini Ramani
 Shri. Nellai Kannan
 Shri. C. V. Chandrasekhar
 Smt. Ambika Kameshwar
 Shri. Jaikishore Mosalikan

Few more legends also extended their help and support whose iden ty has not beentirevealed based on
their request. With the help of all these legends, Divyanjali is now fully equipped and has over 150 books
for reference in its library contributed by Smt. Nandhini Ramani. Divyanjali will always stay grateful to all
these noble hearts without whom the revival would have been much more diﬃcult.

Performances Abroad꞉
Divyanjali’s prominent performances abroad include Cleveland Thyagaraja Festival & ‘Nrithya Nataka
Mala Tour’ in the USA, Navarathri Festival in Bangkok & Singapore and performances in Dubai, UK,
Australia and Sri Lanka.
Creative Endeavors꞉
The dance school has actively hosted lecture demonstrations, workshops, and summer camps for its
students. Dr. S. Divyasena compiled the Adavus of Bharatanatyam and released an audio CD titled
“Nrithyaharam” to help aspiring students to prac ce on their own.
Divyanjali inaugurated its own platform in the year 2017 for providing opportuni es to young deserving
artists to perform under the auspices of Divyanjali’s “Kalarpanam”. Divyanjali also hosted “Sangeet
International Festival” in collabora on with All India Dancers Association (AIDA), in the year 2018,
which featured both music and dance performances of various styles.
Divyanjali published book on ‘Essence and essen als of Rhythm’ authored by BP Haribabu and Duta
Mahima authored by Dr S Divyasena
Media Presence꞉
Divyanjali is privileged to have media presence in Jaya TV, Sun TV, Star Vijay, Makkal TV, Podhigai and
Raj TV. Divyanjali has also featured performances in online channels such as Kavasam web TV and Rasa
Web channel.
Completing 30 Glorious Years of Divine Offerings
꞉

Divyanjali Dance School has conducted 71 Arangetrams so far with the 70th in the year 2026. As of
2024, Divyanjali had completed 30 years of func oning since establishment. To mark the Silver Jubilee
celebrations, Divyanjali conducted Dance festivals, Lecture demonstrations, workshops, and
competitions, month on month, under the banner “Nrithya
Utsav” between July 2019 and February 2020.

About the Founder & Secretary
‘Natyaacharya' Dr. Smt. S. Divyasena
Dr.S.Divyasena, a versa le and accomplished artist got trained in the preliminaries of Bharatanatyam under Smt.
Saroja Rani. She made her stage debut with her Arangetram in 1985. Later she con nued her rigorous training
under 'Yuva Kala Bharathi' Sri. J Suryanarayana Murthy, with great fervor and sincerity. While her time culous
training in Abhinaya happened under 'Padma Bhushan' Late Smt. Kalanidhi Narayanan, her ini a on into
Kuchipudi ensued at the Kuchipudi Arts Academy, which was helmed by the Late legendary Guru 'Padma
Bhushan' Dr. Vempa Chinna Satyam. Dr.S.Divyasena has undergone her ini al years of training in Kuchipudi
under Sri. Udayakanth and Smt. Renuka. Her advanced training in Kuchipudi is now under the tutelage of Sri.
Jaikishore Mosalikan . She has also learnt the art of wielding cymbals, the Na uvangam, from Sri. B P Haribabu.
Dr.S.Divyasena is an 'A' grade artist at Doordarshan. Her academic qualifica on includes a Bachelors in Music,
Masters in Kuchipudi and Doctorate in Bharatanatyam from Sri Chandrasekharendra Saraswathi Viswa
Mahavidyalaya, under the guidance of Dr. Ambika Kameshwar. She is also the secretary of 'Prayathnam'‑ a forum
for young classical dance teachers.
About the Secretary Shri. B. P. Haribabu
A versa le Mridangam exponent Sri.B.P.Haribabu was trained under the guidance of exemplary gurus
'Kalaimamani' Sri.V.P.Ramadoss and 'Kalaimamani' Sri. Thiruvaroor Bhakthavatchalam, at the Tamil Nadu Govt.
Music College. Sri. Haribabu has carved a niche for himself in the dance world. He was conferred the tle
'Vaadhya Visharadha' recognizing his adeptness in the art form. Besides
being an expert Mridangam artist, he is equally proficient in
Pakwaj, Na uvangam and Rhythm composing. He being a
specialist in playing for the Bharatanatyam and
Kuchipudi concerts is the most sought a er
Mridangam artiste who has accompanied
various artistes for over 25 years. His
profound exper se in the field has helped
him a ain accolades world‑wide. Since
1993 he has been extensively
travelling to all major countries

more than 85 tours abroad around
20 countries. He also has to his
credit of working in major Dance
companies in the USA.

Productions
PASURAPADI RAMAYANAM 2023
A thematic production on the life of Lord Rama

SITA KALYANAM 2023
A thematic production on the grand wedding
of Sita with the Lord Rama

THIRUMURUGAATRUPADAI

- 2019
A famous work of Tamil
Literature, from the
Sangam era,
Thirumurugaatrupadai,
was staged as a dance
production depicting the
story behind the birth of
Lord Muruga. The original
work, written by
Nakkeerar was combined
with the Thirupugazh of
Arunagirinadhar, which
details the Arupadai
Veedu of Lord Muruga.
Concept & dance
choreography:
Dr.S.Divyasena
Music: Yuvakalabhara Sri
R.K.Shriramkumar
Resource:
Dr.S.Raghuraman

DASAVATHARAM - 2017
Dasavatharam, a dance production, was
an attempt to visually present the ten
incarnations of Lord Vishnu through
Bharatanatyam with novel lyrics
written by Sri. T. H. Thiyagarajan, who also
composed music & dance choreographed
by Dr. S. Divyasena.

SHIVA SHAKTI MARGAM - 2018
This thematic presentation included compositions penned by various poets
In praise of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvathi, arranged in the format of a Bharathanatyam repertoire.
Concept and dance choreography: Dr. S. Divyasena

ANNAMAYYA NAVARASA NRITHYAMALA - 2016
The popular compositions of Tallapaka
Annamacharya, an ardent devotee of Lord
Venkateshwara were woven into a garland.
The chosen compositions established the
Nava Rasas of Indian theatre.

ANDAL VAIBHAVAM - 2015
This thematic production
was specially made by
selecting and composing
only the verses of Aandal
(Nachiyar thirumozhi) and a
few verses of Periyalwar.
The entire production
revolves around the life of
Aandal from her birth in the
thulasi maadam to her
union with Renganathar.
The production was staged
with a grant offered by the
Iyal Isai Nadaga Mandram,
Tamilnadu.
Dance choreography: Dr. S.
Divyasena
Music: Sri. T. H. Thiyagarajan
Resource: Sri. Kannan

NAVA VIDA SAMBANDAM - 2014
Kulasekara Alwar, one of the 12 Vaishnavite saints,
composed 10 Pasurams in ‘Aindhaam Thirumozhi’,
explaining the relationship between Jeevatma and
Sriman Narayana, by choosing 9 types of mundane
relationships for illustra on. This was presented by
Divyanjali as a dance production, “Nava Vidha
Sambandam”, supported by a grant from the Ministry
of Culture, Central Government of India (under the
Production Grant Scheme).
Dance Choreography: Dr. S. Divyasena
Music: Sri. Rajkumar Bhara
Resource: Sri. Kannan

KRISHNA MARGAM - 2013
The tales of the mischievous Lord Krishna which are
detailed in famous compositions by renowned poets
were presented as a Bharatanatyam repertoire, with
live orchestra.

LAYA THRAYAM - 2013
This dance production was compiled with
the Laya (thala) as the main aspect. It
included various compositions by different
composers and featured a special segment
of thala and swaras highligh ng the layam
concept, that was composed by Sri Srikanth
Gopalakrishnan and Sri B P Haribabu. This
was first staged in New Delhi in 2012 and
later hit the stages during the Margazhi
Season of the same year.

A tribute to Lalgudi Sri G Jayaraman
“A tribute to Lalgudi Sri G
Jayaraman” was presented in the
year 2014. A Bharathanatyam
margam consis ng of the maestro’s
composition were beau fully woven
into a garland and was presented in
front of
Sri Lalgudi Krishnan
& Smt Lalgudi Vijayalakshmi.

PANNUM BHARATHAMUM
“Pannum Bharathamum” was a thematic
presentation in margam format to establish the
importance of Tamil Literature. The nadaswara
vidwan Sri T A P Ravishankar composed a mallari
and a Varnam for the production. The production
was featured on the national daily “The Hindu”.

JAI HANUMAN
This thematic production revolves around the life of Lord Hanuman.
Several unique compositions like Hanuman chalisa, Panchamukha
Hanumath stothram were choreographed and presented as a part of
the production. Music composer: Sri Ramesh Babu,
Dance choreography: Dr. S Divyasena

THRAYEE
"Thrayee" is a tribute to honor the " Sangeetha Mumoorthigal" or the Carnatic Trinity, Thyagaraja,
Shyamasasthri and Muthusamy Dheekshidhar. The production was choreographed as jugalbandhi of
Kuchipudi and Bharatanatyam.
Dance choreography: Sri Jai Kishore Mosalikan (Kuchipudi) & Dr. S. Divyasena (Bharatanatyam)

PURATCHI MANDHAAR
The production revolves around four very strong and powerful women from our ithihasam and
puranam. The lives of Draupathi, Tarai, Mandodhari, and Ahalya were presented in the production.
Lyrics:Dr Raguraman
Dance choreography: Dr Divyasena

Reviews

Nrithya Utsav
2019
Divyanjali is very delighted to have completed 25 years
since establishment. To mark this milestone, Divyanjali
celebrated by conduc ng several events from July 2019 to
March 2020, titled as “Nrithya Utsav” Celebrations. This
included several dance festivals, lecture demonstrations,
dance competitions, quizzes, debates and many other
events. The aim was to provide a platform for the students
and art lovers to learn and flourish.

Kalārpanam
Kalārpanam- a fine arts festival hosted by Divyanjali, aims at providing young and upcoming talents a
wonderful arena to showcase their skills and proficiency in the Indian Fine Arts. Hosting a festival like
Kalārpanam thus encourages and attracts the youth to pursue the arts. The first edition of Kalārpanam was
inaugurated by Smt. Nandini Ramani- a renowned dancer and a dance cri c. The performances of the first
bunch of various young talents were well received among dance teachers, students, and parents thereby
paving the way to host it in future days. Each and every edition of Kalārpanam would happen at different
venues across Chennai and also would reach out to the outskirts that nurture a lot of eﬃcient artists with
very limited exposure.

Natya Satsang
This is a series of lecture demonstrations. Divyanjali has conducted several debates, quiz competitions, and
lectures in associa on with Ganamukundhapriya and Yathnam, to make the youngsters imbibe the various
aspects of dance. It has created several opportuni es, both for its own students and others, to showcase
their performing as well as teaching skills. Teaching sessions have also been conducted abroad in
collabora on with their non-resident students.

Nrithya Saavishkar
This is a series of competitions- a talent search. This is the first time Divyanjali conducted a competition.
The competition was conducted for various age groups ranging fromm 8 to 25 years which as solo
presentations. There was a wide panel of judges who are veterans in the field of dance. Divyanjali provided
the winners of Nrithya saavishkar with cash prizes and an opportunity to perform in a renowned sabha at
Chennai. It strives to be one of the recognized and well-organized competitions in the future.

Nritya Sangamam
An International Dance Festival conducted by Divyanjali featuring artists from different countries including
Singapore, South Africa, USA and Australia. These renowned artists, presented solo presentations in
Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi.

National Seminar On Vachika Abinaya
This was conducted in collabora on with Prayathnam. This seminar featured presentations by various
artists and renowned scholars about the nuances of Vachika Abinaya. This was inaugurated by
Padmabhushan Dr. Padma Subramanyam, who also delivered the keynote address for the seminar. The
seminar also featured paper presentations by students and budding artists.
